meta.title: `.unsafe` code snippet on `const {}` expr results in `unsafe const {}` which is invalid Rust
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#21003 (fix: add block on postfix `.const` completion; merge commit 99bfa4a5, 2025-11-10, first in the 2025-11-17 release; the candidate listed 95a0b20d, the same merge re-imported by a subtree sync)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2025-11-10 and 2025-11-17; git tag --contains puts the fix merge 99bfa4a5 (2025-11-10 05:30 UTC) first in 2025-11-17, and the 2025-11-10 release (0.3.2675, 21f8445ea5, 2025-11-09) predates it. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: The .unsafe postfix completion put 'unsafe' in front of a block-like receiver ('const { 1 }') without a block of its own. Attempt 1 used the candidate's window 2025-11-17 -> 2025-11-24, whose pre build already contains the fix.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: the line verbatim with the cursor marker $0 removed
a library crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/lib.rs. Request completion at the end of 'const { 1 }.unsafe' (line 0, character 42, the issue's $0) and accept the postfix item unsafe. Reported: 'unsafe const { 1 }', which is invalid Rust; expected 'unsafe { const { 1 } }'. Probe: the edited text must have no parse error that the original did not have.

attempts.summary: Window of the candidate mapping, 2025-11-17 -> 2025-11-24 (git tag --contains of the listed sha 95a0b20d puts it first in 2025-11-24): not-reproduced-pre, both builds produced 'const MY_CONST: usize = unsafe { const { 1 } };' (3/3 each). The fix PR #21003 (body: 'Fixes rust-lang/rust-analyzer#20998') was merged 2025-11-10 as 99bfa4a5, which is first in 2025-11-17; 95a0b20d is the same merge re-imported by a later subtree sync. So the listed pre build already contains the fix; the release window recomputed from the merge commit is 2025-11-10 -> 2025-11-17 (pre-check 2).
attempts.verdict: not-reproduced-pre (pre build already contains the fix)
